review_metadata.purpose: Check whether two additional Decision Work Brief cases remain adequate when compared with richer local-private completed-run context, while checking in only safe conclusions.

cases.material_change_summary: Richer local-private context did not overturn the checked-in decision question or action consequence. It made the starting direction and stakeholder constraints clearer: the original path already contained a structured reset possibility, while the later action consequence sharpened authority transfer, stop-loss triggers, customer continuity, and COO alignment.
cases.overconfidence_risk: Medium: the checked-in brief is directionally adequate, but a user-facing version could understate founder relationship, customer trust, team loyalty, equity, legal, board, and governance nuance if the caveats are compressed too far.
cases.source_depth_risk: Private nuance changes confidence and severity more than direction. It clarifies why the action sequence needs governance and relationship review, but it does not safely certify which path is best.
human_followup_questions: What legal, equity, board, and employment constraints govern the proposed authority transition?
How much customer continuity depends on the cofounder personally versus a managed handoff?
What COO and product-lead alignment exists before the CEO conversation?
Would a short reset still preserve dignity and trust, or would it mainly delay an inevitable transition?

cases.material_change_summary: Richer local-private context confirmed the checked-in decision and action-consequence read. It clarified that the original direction was already a constrained pilot, not an unbounded launch, while the revised action consequence sharpened the operating sequence: diagnose the backlog first, keep one clinic and scheduling/billing scope, reduce gate burden, set active pause triggers, and narrow the sales meaning of automation.
cases.overconfidence_risk: Medium: the enriched brief explains the action consequence well, but it could sound too settled if compliance auditability, clinician-attention risk, patient trust, sales promises, and admin capacity stay only in evidence notes.
cases.source_depth_risk: Private nuance does not change the basic direction, but it shows which constraints must remain visible before a user treats the pilot plan as operationally settled.
human_followup_questions: Do compliance and auditability constraints permit even the narrowed pilot on the proposed timeline?
Can the admin team operate the shorter gate set without losing necessary controls?
How should patient trust and clinician-attention risk be monitored during any pilot?
What sales wording avoids implying broader automation than the deployment actually supports?

aggregate_findings.overall_safe_conclusion: Both added checks support the Decision Work Brief shape as a compressed offline artifact, but both also show that private nuance changes confidence, severity, and follow-up questions. The checked-in-safe briefs should remain bounded by source-depth caveats.
aggregate_findings.strongest_useful_signal: Across all three package cases after PR125 and PR146, richer context does not collapse the core action-consequence read. It mainly clarifies what must remain uncertain and what a human should inspect next.
aggregate_findings.strongest_source_depth_private_nuance_ri: Private context is most important for starting-direction overlap, lost-value severity, stakeholder obligations, and legal or compliance constraints. Checked-in-safe summaries can name these limits but cannot settle them.
aggregate_findings.strongest_overclaim_risk: The enriched brief surface could make a compressed conclusion feel more settled than it is, especially if readers miss that the local-private review is provisional and not human validation.

local_private_context_is_needed_for: whether an omitted option was genuinely abandoned
whether a user would endorse the action sequence
source_depth_findings.safe_handling_rule: Future briefs may summarize source-depth conclusions, but they must not copy local-private text or imply that private nuance was human-validated.

overclaim_to_avoid: local-private adequacy means the advice is correct
no material contradiction means Lolla improved the decision
the enriched brief can be treated as an operating plan without human review
private nuance has been safely captured in checked-in-safe public text

decision_gate.rationale: Both preferred additional local-private checks were safely available and neither produced a major contradiction. The next narrow offline test should be the missing third builder/enriched example for the cofounder case, using the existing checked-in-safe brief and any already-created provisional interpretation surface rather than runtime integration.

recommended_next_pr.name: PR147 Decision Work Brief Third Builder Case v0
recommended_next_pr.recommended_scope: Create or prepare the cofounder case as the third offline builder-enriched Decision Work Brief example, preserving the same enrichment rules, source-depth caveats, and non-claims.
